item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya finds four transparent curved objects in her grandfather's old spectacle repair box at home in Jaipur. She wants to identify the convex lens by checking how its thickness changes from the middle to the edges.
Which object is the convex lens?

options.A: an object that is thicker at the edges than in the middle
options.B: an object that is thicker in the middle than at the edges
options.C: an object that has the same thickness all over
options.D: an object that is thick in the middle but does not let light pass through
